name: National Cybersecurity Strategy (2020)

description: National Cybersecurity Strategy of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (December 2020). National Cybersecurity Strategy of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia issued by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA), structured around six strategic objectives towards a 'safe and reliable Saudi cyberspace that enables growth and prosperity' under Saudi Vision 2030.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by الهيئة الوطنية للأمن السيبراني / National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) (nca.gov.sa) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for الهيئة الوطنية للأمن السيبراني / National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) (nca.gov.sa).
